notes:
I found two real Ottawa venues, but neither page confirms hours for September 4 to 6, 2027. That is nearly a year out, and neither venue has posted hours that far ahead. I also only searched museums, so I have no zoo, aquarium or playground picks.

**Canada Agriculture and Food Museum.** 
Ingenium's ticket page says admission is free every day from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m.
 That page doesn't publish opening hours or an age band. Listings elsewhere put it at 901 Prince of Wales Dr, 
open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
, with 
farm animals including cattle, pigs, sheep, horses and poultry
. One listing says 
it is open daily from March to October
, which would cover early September, but that is a third-party listing and not Ingenium's own page.

**Canadian Museum of Nature.** It is at 240 McLeod St, and 
its own page showed "Open today: 9:30 am – 8 pm"
. That is the hours for the day I looked, not for your dates. A roundup site lists a September 2026 to May 2027 winter schedule, but that isn't the museum's own page and doesn't reach September 2027. Check nature.ca closer to your trip.

**Not included.** The Canada Science and Technology Museum, which has a children's zone, showed up only on third-party listings. I couldn't read Ingenium's own page for it, so I left it out. Because September 6, 2027 is Labour Day, it's worth confirming holiday hours before you plan around any of these.
